changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 75 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/10108-form-payload-server-owned-fields.md`

- names `sanitize.ts` → `packages/plugin-form/src/sanitize.ts` — edited by this change

  > **What it was.** The write-side roster in `sanitize.ts` and the render-side roster in `autoLayout.ts` were two hand-written copies of the same list, and they drifted. The render copy had learned to drop `owner_id`; the write copy never did. A form therefore showed the user business inputs only, and sent back every ownership and audit column it had read — `owner_id`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by` — while dropping `created_at` and `organization_id` from the same payload, because those two happened to be in the write copy.
